packages.title: The form's title shows whole once the keyboard is down; a year pick in «Elegir día» applies nothing
brief: Round 2 of b3, run 2026-10-18-commands. P139 is in the working tree (uncommitted) and its reviewer found UX-1002 and UX-1004 fixed (verify-b3-r1-B.md); build on it and don't undo it. Line numbers are from the current working tree; search if they have moved. Two problems are left: UX-1003 (second attempt) and UX-1224 (regression R1B-1 from P139).

UX-1003 (S2), second attempt. What the last attempt did: the title field (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:757-776) got `minLines: 1, maxLines: 3, keyboardType: TextInputType.text` and kept its `textInputAction` (done for tasks). The done action and the 1× one-line check pass. Why it failed: at 2× on 320 dp a line holds about 12–13 Manrope characters (text area 228 dp, 48 dp lines), so the father's own 40-character «Llamar al médico el viernes por la tarde» needs 4 lines; with the cap at 3 the field is 144 dp tall, scrolls by 48 dp, and the first line is out of view with no sign of more. The render build/ux/form/edit-task.long.es.light.2x.png shows the same in the edit form («Pedir cita en el / ayuntamiento / para renovar el», the rest hidden). The fix (the reviewer's first option, settled here over `maxLines: 4`, which still hides longer titles carried from a dictation, up to 160 characters): cap the title at 3 lines only while it has the focus, and remove the cap when it doesn't. Add a `FocusNode _titleFocus` to `_TaskEditorState` (create it with the state, dispose it in `dispose`, :300), pass it as the field's `focusNode`, and listen to it with a listener that calls `setState` when mounted. Set `maxLines: _titleFocus.hasFocus ? 3 : null`; keep `minLines: 1`, `keyboardType: TextInputType.text` (needed: with `maxLines: null` Flutter would otherwise pick the multiline keyboard with a return key), the done/next `textInputAction`, `autofocus: _creating`, `maxLength: 160` and the rest as they are. Why this is safe now: UX-1002's `_dropKeyboard()` (:336) takes the focus off the title on every day and time tap, so the whole title shows exactly when the keyboard is down and there is room; while typing, the keyboard is up and the 3-line cap keeps Hoy and Mañana reachable, as P139 intended. The edit form (no autofocus) and the note editor share the field; showing their whole title is intended. Update the field's comment (:760-763) to: «A new task opens with the keyboard up. Its Done key only closes the keyboard: the day comes next. While typing, a long title wraps up to three lines so the days still show; without the focus it shows whole.»

UX-1003, the failing test: App/test/new_task_form_test.dart:1431 ('UX-1003: at 2× on 320 dp a 40-character title shows whole on at most 3 lines…') encodes the old acceptance and is rightly broken by the new rule. Update it to this package's first two acceptance checks, keeping its passing parts (done action, no multiline keyboard, no newline on done). Leave the 1× test at :1463 unchanged.

UX-1224 (S2, regression R1B-1 from P139): picking a year in «Elegir día» applies a day nobody chose. Where: App/lib/widgets/schedule_editor.dart:294-305, the CalendarDatePicker's `onDateChanged: (day) { _select(day); if (widget.dayOnly) _done(); }`. The range is 2000–2101 (`pickerFirstDate`/`pickerLastDate`, App/lib/l10n/region.dart:221-230), so the header «octubre de 2026 ▾» opens the year grid. Flutter's `_handleYearChanged` (C:/Users/mikig/Desktop/Custom/Flutter/flutter/packages/flutter/lib/src/material/calendar_date_picker.dart:296-317) switches back to the day grid and calls `onDateChanged` with the selected day number (or 1 when none) in the year tapped, in the month that was showing; it fires `onDisplayedMonthChanged` first, and for a tap on the year already shown it fires no month change at all. So neither the date nor a month comparison tells a year pick from a day tap reliably. Fix: in day-only mode, apply and close only on a tap in the day grid. A year pick is the only way `onDateChanged` fires while the year grid is on screen: the CalendarDatePicker builds a `YearPicker` only in year mode (:366-374), and the callback runs before the rebuild, so that `YearPicker` is still mounted. Wrap the calendar in a `KeyedSubtree` with a new `GlobalKey _calendarBox` (keep the CalendarDatePicker's own `ValueKey('schedule-calendar-$_day')`), add a helper `bool _yearGridShown()` that walks `_calendarBox.currentContext` with `visitChildElements` (recursively) and returns true when it finds an element whose widget is a `YearPicker`, and write `onDateChanged` as: in day-only mode, `if (_yearGridShown()) return;` (no `_select`, no `_done`: the calendar moves itself to that year's month and nothing in the sheet changes); otherwise `_select(day); _done();`. The full sheet (not day-only) keeps `_select(day)` for every change, as now. Don't narrow the date range (the reviewer's optional idea): it would limit which days can be chosen and doesn't remove the problem. No copy change.

Don't touch: P139's day-only sheet otherwise (title `pickDay`, no time switch, no «Listo», «Cancelar» kept, Hoy/Mañana/Sin fecha chips applying at once), `_dropKeyboard`, the time picker's input mode, the edit form's and the capture result's full sheet, P140's collapsed details. A side effect P139's implementer noted (an empty title that loses the focus at 2× on 320 dp shows its label inside the field, cut to «Título de la ta…») is outside this package; leave it.
acceptance: ES, Manrope, 2× on 320×640 with the keyboard: in Nueva tarea, type «Llamar al médico el viernes por la tarde» (40 characters) into the focused title; the field shows at most 3 lines, scrolls only vertically (no horizontal scroll), and the keyboard's done action adds no line break.

ES, Manrope, 2× on 320×640: then tap Mañana (nothing has the focus; reset the 300 dp inset to stand for the keyboard going down, as P139's implementer noted); the title field shows all 4 lines with no scroll extent (maxScrollExtent 0), and its first word «Llamar» is visible.
ES, Manrope, 2× on 360×740: the edit form of a task titled «Pedir cita en el ayuntamiento para renovar el DNI» (title not focused) shows the whole title, including «DNI», with no scroll extent.
ES, 1× on 390 dp: a 20-character title stays on one line (the existing test at App/test/new_task_form_test.dart:1463 still passes).

ES: from the form, open «Elegir día», tap the calendar's month header («octubre de 2026 ▾», or the month shown), tap 2027: the sheet is still open, the calendar shows a month of 2027 in the day grid, and the form's third chip still reads «Elegir día» (nothing applied). Then tap day 15: the sheet closes and the third chip shows that date's weekdayDate. A time set before is kept.
ES: from the form, open «Elegir día», tap the month header, tap the year already shown (2026): the sheet is still open and nothing is applied.

ES: from the form, open «Elegir día» and tap a date 9 days ahead: the sheet closes and the third chip shows that date (P139's acceptance still passes). The edit form's and the capture result's date sheets still have «Añadir hora» and «Listo», and a year pick there still only selects.
deviceChecks: Phone, the largest font on a 360 dp phone, in Spanish: type «Llamar al médico el viernes por la tarde», tap Mañana; the keyboard goes down and the whole title shows on the form.
Phone: «Elegir día», tap «octubre de 2026 ▾», tap 2027; the sheet stays open on a 2027 month, and only a tapped day closes it.

packages.title: Renaming a dictated project: an existing project's name files the tasks there; a pencil shows the row can be renamed
brief: Round 2 of b3, run 2026-10-18-commands. P141 is in the working tree (uncommitted) and its reviewer found UX-1103 to UX-1106 fixed (verify-b3-r1-C.md); build on its rename path and don't undo it. Two problems came with that path: UX-1225 (regression R1C-1) and UX-1226 (regression R1C-2). Line numbers are from the current working tree; search if they have moved.

UX-1225 (S2, regression R1C-1 from P141): a rename to the name of a project the person already has still says «(nuevo)». What happens now: «Usar este nombre» (App/lib/widgets/task_list_picker.dart:98-103) passes the typed name up, and `_renameProject` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:2419-2446) writes it onto the project card and the tasks as a new project, so the card reads «Nuevo proyecto: Física» and the chip «Física (nuevo)»; at save, `_apply` (:2938-2944) finds the editable project with the same folded name and files the tasks there. The result said one thing and did another. Fix, in `_renameProject` only: after trimming, look for an editable project with the same folded name, folded as the save does (`foldForSearch(spokenProjectName(name))` against `foldForSearch(p.name.trim())`, over `editableProjects(ref.read(taskListsProvider).valueOrNull ?? const [])`). If there is none, keep today's rename. If there is one (`same`), treat it as tapping that project's row, as `_changeCommand`'s `picked` branch does (:2371-2401): every project card (`CommandKind.project`, not removed, not existing) whose name matches `from` (`_sameProject`) becomes `command.copyWith(choice: same.id)`, so it shows as an existing project («Ya tienes «Física»» with «La tarea va ahí.», App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart:472-483); and every pending task whose `newProject` matches `from` becomes `draft.copyWith(task: taskWithProject(draft.task, same), clearNewProject: true)`, so its chip shows the plain «Física» with no «(nuevo)». Do both in one `setState`, clear `_error`, then `await _write()`, as now. Cover tasks going to that name without a project card too (the save collects `draft.newProject` names on their own, :2934-2936). Nothing is created or changed before the confirming tap.

UX-1225, settled here: a name that matches only a project the person can view, not edit, stays a new project. The chip keeps «Física (nuevo)» and the save creates the person's own «Física», exactly as when that name is dictated directly (`_apply` reuses only `editableProjects`). That is what the screen says, and a task can't go into a view-only project. No new copy.

UX-1226 (S1, regression R1C-2 from P141): nothing shows that the dictated row can be renamed. In `chooseTaskList` (App/lib/widgets/task_list_picker.dart:55-64), the dictated project's ListTile is marked `selected` and has no cue that a tap fixes its name. When `onRename != null`, add `trailing: Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 20, semanticLabel: context.l10n.commandRenameProject)`; with `onRename == null` (a card disabled while saving) the row stays as it is, with no pencil. No existing key fits (`editList` is «Editar proyecto», `groupRename` names a group), so add a new key `commandRenameProject` to all three ARB files, next to `commandUseName`: EN “Change the name” / ES «Cambiar el nombre» / CA «Canvia el nom» (the organizer wrote the Catalan, after `groupRename`'s «Canvia el nom del grup»). @description in app_en.arb: “TalkBack name of the pencil on the project sheet's row for a project a dictation creates; a tap on the row opens the dialog that corrects that project's name. Nothing is created until the result's confirming tap.” Run flutter gen-l10n.

Tests this change rightly breaks: a test that expects «Nuevo proyecto: …» or «… (nuevo)» after a rename to an existing editable project's name, if one exists; update only that. P141's tests (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart from :4417; the rename at :4654) must keep passing, as must 'a plain single-task dictation looks and saves exactly as before, with no new tap'.

Don't touch: the dialog itself (`_ProjectNameDialog`: its title, field, 80-character limit and buttons), the chip copy `commandNewProjectChip`, `commandMemberNotInNew`, the person chip's ▾, the «Otro proyecto…» question (P135), D7's person-chip rule (P159, later).
acceptance: ES: with an existing editable project «Física» (fixture `physics`) and a result with a dictated new project «Fisica 2» holding one task: open the task's project chip, tap the «Nuevo proyecto: Fisica 2» row, type «física», tap «Usar este nombre». The task's chip reads «Física» with no «(nuevo)»; no text on screen contains «Nuevo proyecto: física» or «(nuevo)»; the project card reads «Ya tienes «Física»». After the confirming tap no project is created and the task is saved in project id 'physics'.

ES: the same rename with «Química» typed (no project of that name): the chip reads «Química (nuevo)», and after the confirming tap one project «Química» is created holding the task (P141's rename still works).
ES: with only a view-only project «Física» (canEdit false) and the same rename to «física»: the chip still ends in «(nuevo)», and the save creates one new project.

ES and CA: the project sheet of a task going to a dictated new project shows an Icons.edit_outlined at the end of the «Nuevo proyecto: …» row, and the row's semantics include «Cambiar el nombre» (CA «Canvia el nom»); with the card disabled while saving (onRename null) there is no pencil.
ES, Manrope, 2× on 320×640: the pencil lies wholly inside the sheet and the screen, and the row's title still shows without overflow. Render the sheet for the reviewer.
deviceChecks: Phone, TalkBack, in Spanish: on the project sheet of a dictated new project, the row reads its name and «Cambiar el nombre».
